because: Cover attaches. The loss happened on 18 March, so the limit that responds is the 500,000 in force on that date, not the 750,000 the June endorsement backdated to 1 May -- the endorsement cannot reach a loss that predates its own effective date. Goods on the quayside awaiting loading are in transit for the purposes of Clause 7B, so the peril is within cover; settle at the 500,000 limit less the 10,000 deductible.

settles_wording.reading: goods on the quayside awaiting loading are in transit for the purposes of Clause 7B
